item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Iranian Delegation Arrives at Peace Talks, With Vance en Route
item.summary: There was much uncertainty about the durability of the cease-fire and whether the two sides could reach a long-term deal, as Vice President JD Vance traveled to Pakistan for the talks.

item.title: Lebanon: Images of a Nation Uprooted by War
item.summary: A million people in Lebanon have fled their homes as Israel clashes anew with Hezbollah. This is what their lives look now.

item.title: Iran’s South Africa Mission Trolls Trump Amid Hormuz Ceasefire
item.summary: Official social media accounts for Iranian embassies have engaged in information warfare, but the ones in Africa appear to have taken the lead on the attacks.

item.title: Iran’s Battered Leaders Emerge From War Confident — and With New Cards
item.summary: For Iran’s theocratic rulers, just surviving the U.S.-Israeli onslaught means victory. But the seeds of their next crisis may already be planted.

item.title: New Evidence Further Implicates U.S. Missiles in Strikes That Killed 21 Civilians in Iran
item.summary: Additional images and video build on an earlier analysis, which the Pentagon has disputed, showing Precision Strike Missiles, or PrSMs, hit a sports hall and residential areas in the Iranian city of Lamerd.

item.title: Facing Many Crises, Pakistan Tries to End a Big One — in Iran
item.summary: A nation with a stalled economy, a terrorism problem and two hostile neighbors is set to host the first formal U.S.-Iranian talks since the war began.

item.title: With Iran Setting Limits, Strait of Hormuz Remains Thorny Politically
item.summary: Even after a cease-fire, Iran is keeping a chokehold on traffic, forcing countries to cut deals that could put them at odds with the U.S.

item.title: Trump Is Racing to Redefine ‘America First’ in a Time of War
item.summary: Washington has been debating the thrust of Mr. Trump’s foreign policy for more than a decade, with the only consensus being that “America First” means whatever the president says it does.

item.title: With U.S.-Iran Peace Talks Set to Begin, Prospects for Long-Term Deal Uncertain
item.summary: As U.S. and Iranian leaders head to Pakistan for negotiations amid a two-week cease-fire, the two sides must resolve major differences on Lebanon, the Strait of Hormuz and frozen Iranian assets.

item.title: ‘I’m Fed Up.’ Frustrated With Trump, Starmer Embraces Other Allies.
item.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer of Britain is strengthening ties in Europe and the Middle East as the once-special relationship with America sours.
